Class ViewExperience

java.lang.Object
guiExperience.ViewExperience
public class ViewExperience extends Object

Title: ViewExperience Class.

Description: The JavaFX-based Experience View. This class displays the Add Experience form using the Contributor sage theme and forwards submitted values to the Experience Controller.

Version:
1.0 2026-10-23 Initial version after MVC refactoring
Author:
Venus Ho, Alexander Murray, Alan Shimp, Caleb Beaven, Krithik Duraisamy

    • displayAddExperience

      protected static void displayAddExperience(javafx.stage.Stage owner, entityClasses.User user, Integer selectedLessonId, Runnable onCreated)

      Method: displayAddExperience()

      Description: Displays the Add Experience form and connects its actions to the Experience Controller.

      Parameters:
      owner - window that owns the Add Experience form
      user - active contributor creating the Experience
      selectedLessonId - optional Lesson ID used to populate the form
      onCreated - operation used to refresh the calling page

      row - grid row receiving the controls

      protected static void showMessage(javafx.stage.Stage owner, String title, String message, boolean error)

      Method: showMessage()

      Description: Displays a styled success or error message associated with the Add Experience form.

      Parameters:
      owner - form that owns the message window
      title - message-window title
